description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller 'FilesController' responsible for handling HTTP requests related to serving static and product files in an e-commerce web application. It provides endpoints for downloading files associated with stores and products, with role-based access controls for certain operations.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling file download requests, serving static files and product files with role restrictions.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to serve static files from the store repository based on store code, filename, and extension. Returns file content as byte array or sends a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: downloadProduct
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to serve product digital files, accessible only to users with the 'PRODUCTS' role. Sets 'Content-Disposition' header for downloads and returns the file data or 404 if not found.
